rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for an unprepared guess or comment made without much thought.

example.english: Don’t give an offhand answer about the price; check first.
example.traditional: 你唔好隨口答個價錢，查清楚先。
example.jyutping: nei5 m4 hou2 ceoi4 hau2 daap3 go3 gaa3 cin4 caa4 cing1 co2 sin1

rows.note: Use this when the emphasis is on doing something right away, rather than on speaking without thinking.

example.english: They left offhand after the meeting, without even saying goodbye.
example.traditional: 散會之後，佢哋即刻走，連聲再見都冇講。
example.jyutping: saan3 wui2 zi1 hau6 keoi5 dei6 zik1 hak1 zau2 lin4 seng1 zoi3 gin3 dou1 mou5 gong2

rows.note: Use this when the abrupt manner is specifically chilly or unfriendly, especially in a reply.

example.traditional: 佢冷冷淡淡咁答我：「唔知呀。」
example.jyutping: keoi5 laang5 laang5 daam6 daam6 gam3 daap3 ngo5 m4 zi1 aa3
